name: Type 38 75 mm Field Gun
blurb: A Hangar-only field piece with traversing upper carriage and elevating barrel, prepared for Leyte defensive-site dressing.
history: The Type 38 was a Japanese seventy-five-millimetre field gun derived from a Krupp design. This review model preserves the split-trail, shieldless working silhouette selected in F3 while marking its envelope and carriage geometry as estimates.

sources.title: Handbook on Japanese Military Forces, U.S. War Department
